	private SkillActivities()
	{
	}

	static SkillActivity fromAnimation(int animationId)
	{
		return BY_ANIMATION.get(animationId);
	}

	/** A wall-rock swing, which drops to idle between pay-dirt while the rock is still live. */
	static boolean isWallMining(int animationId)
	{
		return WALL_MINING.contains(animationId);
	}

	/**
	 * XP that means "this skill is being trained". Prayer and magic are excluded
	 * because combat grants them too.
	 */
	static SkillActivity fromSkillXp(Skill skill)
	{
		switch (skill)
		{
			case WOODCUTTING:
				return SkillActivity.WOODCUTTING;
			case MINING:
				return SkillActivity.MINING;
			case FISHING:
				return SkillActivity.FISHING;
			case HUNTER:
				return SkillActivity.HUNTER;
			case AGILITY:
				return SkillActivity.AGILITY;
			case THIEVING:
				return SkillActivity.THIEVING;
			case FARMING:
				return SkillActivity.FARMING;
			case RUNECRAFT:
				return SkillActivity.RUNECRAFT;
			case CONSTRUCTION:
				return SkillActivity.CONSTRUCTION;
			case COOKING:
				return SkillActivity.COOKING;
			case FIREMAKING:
				return SkillActivity.FIREMAKING;
			case SMITHING:
				return SkillActivity.SMITHING;
			case FLETCHING:
				return SkillActivity.FLETCHING;
			case CRAFTING:
				return SkillActivity.CRAFTING;
			case HERBLORE:
				return SkillActivity.HERBLORE;
			case SAILING:
				return SkillActivity.SAILING;
			default:
				return null;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * The skill an activity trains. Melee gives Attack here; the plugin picks
	 * Strength or Defence from where the XP actually goes.
	 */
	static Skill skillFor(SkillActivity activity)
	{
		switch (activity)
		{
			case MELEE:
				return Skill.ATTACK;
			case RANGED:
				return Skill.RANGED;
			case MAGIC:
				return Skill.MAGIC;
			case PRAYER:
				return Skill.PRAYER;
			default:
				for (Skill skill : Skill.values())
				{
					if (fromSkillXp(skill) == activity)
					{
						return skill;
					}
				}
				return null;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Icon for a level-up in any skill, including the combat skills that have no activity.
	 */
	static String levelUpIcon(Skill skill)
	{
		switch (skill)
		{
			case ATTACK:
				return SkillActivity.MELEE.iconData();
			case STRENGTH:
				return PixelIcon.STRENGTH.iconData();
			case DEFENCE:
				return PixelIcon.DEFENCE.iconData();
			case HITPOINTS:
				return PixelIcon.HITPOINTS.iconData();
			case SLAYER:
				return PixelIcon.SLAYER.iconData();
			case RANGED:
				return SkillActivity.RANGED.iconData();
			case MAGIC:
				return SkillActivity.MAGIC.iconData();
			case PRAYER:
				return SkillActivity.PRAYER.iconData();
			default:
				SkillActivity activity = fromSkillXp(skill);
				return activity == null ? null : activity.iconData();
		}
	}

	private static int wall(int animationId)
	{
		WALL_MINING.add(animationId);
		return animationId;
	}

	private static void bind(SkillActivity activity, int... animationIds)
	{
		for (int animationId : animationIds)
		{
			SkillActivity previous = BY_ANIMATION.put(animationId, activity);
			if (previous != null && previous != activity)
			{
				throw new IllegalStateException("Animation " + animationId + " is both " + previous + " and " + activity);
			}
		}
	}
}

	private final String label;
	private final Color color;
	private final String[] rows;
	private String iconData;

	SkillActivity(String label, int rgb, String[] rows)
	{
		this.label = label;
		this.color = new Color(rgb);
		this.rows = rows;
	}

	String label()
	{
		return label;
	}

	Color color()
	{
		return color;
	}

	/**
	 * Inline AWTRIX icon: base64 GIF, which the device treats as image data
	 * once the string is longer than 64 characters.
	 */
	String iconData()
	{
		if (iconData == null)
		{
			iconData = SkillActivityIcons.gif(rows);
		}
		return iconData;
	}
